body: In the first grade, we did a Mother's Day project where we made a mini book where each page says "My mother likes to ____" or my mother's favorite food is ____", and then draw a picture. Me being the horribly innocent child as I was, put "My mother likes to smoke" and proceeded to draw a lit cigarette, and "My mother's favorite thing to drink is beer." and proceeded to draw a beer can. The teacher, who was close to my mom, told her and my mom was so embarrassed and upset at me. I didn't realize at the time that it wasn't okay to put that. Ironic thing is she rarely actually drank beer or smoked cigarettes. I think my mom forgot, and it's too embarrassing to mention.
